03/10.01.2025 Heard the Parties.
Both these bail applications arise out of same police case.
Accordingly, they are being disposed of by a common order.

Petitioners have been made an accused in connection with Goilkera P.S. case No.19/2024 registered under section 376-D, 342, 313, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Learned S.D.J.M. Porahat West Singhbhum at Chaibasa.
The petitioners who are friends are alleged to have gang raped the victim.

Statement of the victim has been recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. in which she has stated that her marriage was fixed with the petitioner Budhan Singh Purty.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case and considering the nature of allegation;
I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioners on bail.
Accordingly, their prayer for bail is hereby rejected.
